children: may fall into a range of $91.82 to $92.78 per barrel, following its failure to break resistance at $96.73.

The failure indicates a completion of the bounce from $88.73. A retracement analysis on the bounce reveals support at $93.73, the 38.2% level, which looks unable to hold, as the market is retesting it.
A break above $94.91 may lead to a gain into the $95.64-$96.82 range.
